about: The atlas phase ids of the sister house (lucky-mem), as a fixed list, and every deliberate difference between the two atlases. test/atlas-phase-parity.test.mjs compares bench/atlas.mjs against it. Update it in the same commit that adds, renames or removes a phase in either house; a difference that is not listed here, with a reason, turns the test red.

luckyMemPending.skala: being built in the sibling house on branch agent/atlas-skala-lm; the id is the one this house uses
luckyMemPending.kennungen: being built in the sibling house on branch agent/atlas-skala-lm; this house calls it identifiers

idMapReason: The identifiers phase has one name per house because the houses speak different languages (this one ships English only). The scale phase has the same id in both houses, `skala`: it is a name, not prose, and the English ratchet allows it (checked 2026-10-11).

cmOnly.reason: The register prototype (sqlite+FTS5) against the linear scan. It answers a question about this house's search design that the sister house has not asked.

lmOnly.reason: The sister house's runner records a tree fingerprint (path, size, mtime) of the real memory before and after the run. This house guards the same thing inside its real phase (test/atlas-real-guard-origin.test.mjs).
